sources.citation: Barbour, Julie. 2016. An account of possession in Larevet. Language and Linguistics in Melanesia 34(1): 139-163.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: a digital copy exists, behind a library sign-in
sources.note: Section 2 'An overview of Larevet' (pp. 140-141) gives only the phoneme inventory (19 consonants; vowels /i e a ə o u/; /j w/ onset-only) and basic word order; no mention of stress, accent, syllable weight or prosody anywhere in the article (a full-text search for stress/accent/penult: none). Author notes this is 'the first published analysis of Larevet data' (p. 140), based on a 15-text Larevet Corpus.
